anchor.method: FY2026E income statement = 9M-2026 actuals + iterative Q4 estimate; FY2026E balance sheet = 30 Sep 2026 actuals + Q4 growth; FY2027E-FY2030E linked to macro.csv nominal GDP, CPI, policy rate, T-bills, and 10Y bond yield.

q4_2026_loan_growth_pct.note: Q4-2026 net loan growth over 30 Sep 2026.

q4_2026_deposit_growth_pct.note: Q4-2026 customer deposit growth over 30 Sep 2026.

q4_2026_flow_scale.note: Q4-2026 non-interest income and opex run-rate as fraction of 9M-2026.

loan_spread_over_nom_gdp_pct.note: FY2027E+ loan growth = nominal GDP (from macro.csv) + 2.0%.

deposit_spread_over_nom_gdp_pct.note: FY2027E+ deposit growth = nominal GDP (from macro.csv) + 0.5%.

yield_on_investments_spread_over_blend_p.note: 50% tbill_364d_pct + 50% govt_bond_yield_pct from macro.csv - 4.0% (calibrated to 9M-2026 actual ~8.5% blended asset yield).

yield_on_loans_spread_over_policy_pct.note: policy_rate_pct from macro.csv + 1.0% (calibrated to 9M-2026 actual interest income ~884m annualised).

cost_of_funds_spread_over_tbill91_pct.note: max(1.5%, tbill_91d_pct - 3.6%), calibrated to 9M-2026 actual ~2.0% cost of funds.

cost_of_risk_pct.note: FY2026E near zero on 9M-2026 recoveries; normalizes to 1.4-1.5%.

dividend_payout_pct.note: 20% payout applied ONLY once retained_earnings > 0 AND car_pct >= target_car_pct.

target_car_pct.note: Target CAR proxy buffer above 13.0% min_car_pct.

q4_2026_loan_growth_pct.note: Q4-2026 net loan growth over 30 Sep 2026.

q4_2026_flow_scale.note: Q4-2026 non-interest income and opex run-rate.

dividend_payout_pct.note: 10% payout only if retained_earnings > 0 and CAR >= target.
